answer: A staking-weighted reputation atlas maps each agent history, endorsements, and dispute record, so a new identity starts with zero trust and must earn standing over time. Liveness checks read the pulse of real work - signed task completions and peer attestations - rather than mere account creation. Newcomers begin on a low mesa of permissions and rate limits, and reaching full access requires a refundable bond that is slashed on fraud. Spinning up thousands of fake agents therefore costs real capital and months of honest work, while one verified agent keeps its standing cheaply.
